description: Full metadata for a StatCan cube: dimensions, member trees, frequency, geography, last release. Use it to construct a coordinate string for statcan_cube_data, and to turn a coordinate back into labels: pass `coordinate` (e.g. "12.1.1.0.0.0.0.0.0.0") to get the member name at every position (position 1 is usually Geography), or `dimension` (position or name, e.g. 1 or "Geography") to list EVERY member of that dimension with its id; without either, each dimension lists only its first 10 members and says when it is truncated. Does NOT return vector IDs, for that use statcan_cube_vectors, which enumerates the actual vector id for every dimension-member combination in the cube.

coordinate.description: Optional: a dot-separated coordinate as used by statcan_cube_data, e.g. "12.1.1.0.0.0.0.0.0.0". Returns coordinate_labels: for each non-zero position the dimension name, member id and member NAME (so "the Geography label for coordinate 12.1.1..." is answered directly).

dimension.description: Optional: a dimension position (1, 2, ...) or a case-insensitive name fragment (e.g. "Geography"). Returns every member of the matching dimension(s), up to 2,000 each, instead of the first 10.

product_id.description: Cube product ID (8-digit, e.g. 36100434 = quarterly GDP, 35100005 = youth admissions to correctional services).

name: statcan_cube_metadata
title: Statcan Cube Metadata
